slot.brief: Solve an equation reducible to a single trig function (e.g. via factorising sin/cos) and state the general solution set; standard.

stem: The general solution of $\sin 2x=\sin x$ is

verdicts.working: Factor: sin x(2 cos x − 1) = 0. Thus x = nπ or x = ±π/3 + 2nπ, matching (A).

working:
$\sin 2x-\sin x=0\Rightarrow \sin x(2\cos x-1)=0$.\n$\sin x=0\Rightarrow x=n\pi$.\n$\cos x=\dfrac12\Rightarrow x=\pm\dfrac{\pi}{3}+2n\pi$, $n\in\mathbb{Z}$.

Independent check: Factor: sin x(2 cos x − 1) = 0. Thus x = nπ or x = ±π/3 + 2nπ, matching (A).
solution:
Using $\sin 2x=2\sin x\cos x$,
$$\sin x(2\cos x-1)=0.$$
Thus $\sin x=0$ gives $x=n\pi$, while $\cos x=\frac12$ gives $x=\pm\frac{\pi}{3}+2n\pi$, where $n\in\mathbb Z$.
